company_description: Avery Dennison Corporation operates as a materials science and digital identification solutions company in North America, Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, Asia, and Latin America. It offers pressure-sensitive label materials, which consist of papers, plastic films, and metal foils; performance tapes products, including mechanical fasteners, which are precision-extruded and injection-molded plastic devices; and other pressure-sensitive adhesive-based materials and converted products under the Fasson, JAC, and Avery Dennison brands. The company provides graphics and reflective products that include films and other products for the architectural, commercial sign, digital printing, and other related market segments; durable cast and reflective films to the construction, automotive, and fleet transportation markets; sign shops, commercial printers, and designers for pressure-sensitive materials; reflective films for traffic and safety applications; and pressure-sensitive vinyl and specialty materials for digital imaging, screen printing, and sign cutting applications under the Avery Dennison and Mactac brand names. kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not quantified directly, but the effects of raw material deflation on pricing are mentioned as a key factor.
kpis.signal: Stable margin despite pricing pressure from raw material deflation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before taxes relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not provided, but the decline in net income is explained by higher costs despite productivity gains.
kpis.signal: Operating margin impacted by higher labor and interest expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount the company invests in innovation and development of new products.
kpis.description: No data on research and development expenditures in the provided documents.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new plants, machinery, or equipment.
kpis.description: Documents do not mention capital expenditures.

kpis.name: Workforce Reduction
kpis.explanation: Number of positions eliminated as part of the 2025 restructuring plan.
kpis.description: In 2025, the company reduced approximately 1,200 positions under its restructuring plan, recording $48.8 million in restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Reduction of 1,200 positions as part of a cost optimization initiative.

kpis.name: Adjusted Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash available after operating and investing expenses, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: The term is defined in the MD&A as operating cash flow minus capex and software expenses, plus or minus certain gains and losses. No value is provided in the documents.
kpis.signal: No figure available, but the concept is used to assess financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.8 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €3.73 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of $0.94 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.288 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 41.9% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years reported in 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $8.855 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years reported in 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.688 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Organic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in revenue excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects.
kpis.description: In 2025, organic growth is flat: volume increases are offset by price declines due to raw material deflation.
kpis.signal: Zero organic growth in 2025, despite volume gains offset by price declines.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all costs and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income decreased from $705 M in 2024 to $688 M in 2025, due to higher labor, interest, and investment costs, partially offset by productivity gains.
kpis.signal: Decline in net income in 2025 despite productivity gains.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions and changes in international economic and social conditions may reduce demand and market access.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 50 countries and 69% of revenue comes from international operations. Geopolitical tensions between the U.S., China, India, and the European Union, as well as changes in economic conditions and trade regulations, could have a significant negative impact. risks.title: Climate and Environmental Risk
risks.summary: Climate change and environmental regulations may increase costs and affect operational continuity.
risks.score_rationale: Climate change and stricter environmental regulations could increase operating costs and create additional compliance obligations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Risk
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions may increase costs and reduce product availability.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates over 200 manufacturing and distribution facilities in more than 50 countries, making it vulnerable to supply chain disruptions. (default score, to be refined)
